_comment: plugged.host devbox egg, shipped with plugged-host-devbox and upserted by plugged-host:devbox-setup. Hidden from server creation (tag 'hidden').
name: plugged.host Devbox
author: support@plugged.host
description: System egg: the Linux devbox Wings runs next to a game server for VS Code. Created and managed by the plugged-host-devbox plugin; never offered to users.

variables.name: Devbox token
variables.description: Bearer token the devbox uses to reach the panel. Rotated on every start by the plugin.

variables.name: Panel URL
variables.description: Where the devbox reaches the panel.

variables.name: Web certificate
variables.description: The devbox's TLS certificate for VS Code in the browser (base64 PEM, issued per start).

variables.name: Web key
variables.description: Its private key (base64 PEM, issued per start).

variables.name: Edge CA
variables.description: The CA that signs the edge's client certificate (base64 PEM).
